# anthropic_external_key (Resource)

Registers a customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) held in AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS or Azure Key Vault. Attach it to a workspace with `external_key_id` on `anthropic_workspace`.

Requires `admin_api_key` or `oauth_token`.

~> A key can only be deleted while unattached, and `provider_config` cannot change once attached. Changing `provider_config` or `geo` forces a new registration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anthropic_external_key" "production" {
  display_name       = "production-us"
  validate_on_create = true

  provider_config = {
    type    = "aws"
    kms_arn = "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555"
  }
}

# Attach the key to a workspace (write-once).
resource "anthropic_workspace" "production" {
  name            = "Production"
  external_key_id = anthropic_external_key.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_config` (Attributes) Where the key lives. Changing any field forces a new registration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provider_config))

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name. Removing it clears the name.
- `geo` (String) Geography the key serves. Only `us` today. Defaults to `us`; changing it forces a new registration.
- `validate_on_create` (Boolean) Call the validate endpoint after registering the key and fail if the key is not reachable. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `attachment_type` (String) `attached` when a workspace uses the key, otherwise `unattached`.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) External key id (`ekey_...`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--provider_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provider_config`

Required:

- `type` (String) `aws`, `gcp` or `azure`.

Optional:

- `client_id` (String) Azure client id used to access the vault.
- `key_name` (String) Google Cloud KMS key resource name, or Azure Key Vault key name. Required for `gcp` and `azure`.
- `kms_arn` (String) AWS KMS key ARN. Required for `aws`.
- `region` (String) AWS region of the key. Derived from `kms_arn` when omitted.
- `tenant_id` (String) Azure tenant id. Required for `azure`.
- `vault_uri` (String) Azure Key Vault or Managed HSM URI. Required for `azure`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_external_key.production ekey_01ExampleKeyId00000000000
```
